faq.question_en: Which Malaysian Standard applies to cosmetics for halal certification?
faq.question_bm: Standard Malaysia yang mana terpakai untuk pensijilan halal kosmetik?
faq.answer_formal_en: Cosmetic and personal care products are assessed against MS 2200-1 (Islamic consumer goods, Part 1: Cosmetic and personal care, general guidelines) under the Malaysian Halal Certification Procedure Manual. [SAHKAN: current edition year and manual revision]
faq.answer_layman_en: For cosmetics, the halal yardstick is MS 2200 Part 1, not the food standard MS 1500.
faq.answer_formal_bm: Produk kosmetik dan penjagaan diri dinilai berdasarkan MS 2200-1 (Barangan gunaan Islam, Bahagian 1: Kosmetik dan penjagaan diri, garis panduan umum) di bawah Manual Prosedur Pensijilan Halal Malaysia. [SAHKAN: tahun edisi semasa dan semakan manual]
faq.answer_layman_bm: Untuk kosmetik, ukuran halalnya ialah MS 2200 Bahagian 1, bukan standard makanan MS 1500.

faq.question_en: Does a halal-certified premise still need a KKM food premise licence?
faq.question_bm: Adakah premis bersijil halal masih perlu lesen premis makanan KKM?
faq.answer_formal_en: Yes. Halal certification (JAKIM / JAIN / MAIN) and food-safety registration with the Ministry of Health (Food Act 1983 and Food Regulations 1985; MeSTI or HACCP where applicable) are separate requirements and both apply. [SAHKAN: which registration the premise category requires]
faq.answer_layman_en: Two different doors: halal is JAKIM, food safety is KKM. You need both.
faq.answer_formal_bm: Ya. Pensijilan halal (JAKIM / JAIN / MAIN) dan pendaftaran keselamatan makanan dengan Kementerian Kesihatan (Akta Makanan 1983 dan Peraturan-Peraturan Makanan 1985; MeSTI atau HACCP jika berkenaan) ialah keperluan berasingan dan kedua-duanya terpakai. [SAHKAN: pendaftaran yang diperlukan mengikut kategori premis]
faq.answer_layman_bm: Dua pintu berbeza: halal ialah JAKIM, keselamatan makanan ialah KKM. Kedua-duanya perlu.

faq.question_en: Is a cosmetic product with a halal certificate exempt from NPRA notification?
faq.question_bm: Adakah produk kosmetik yang mempunyai sijil halal dikecualikan daripada notifikasi NPRA?
faq.answer_formal_en: No. Notifikasi Kosmetik with NPRA under the Control of Drugs and Cosmetics Regulations 1984 is required before a cosmetic is marketed in Malaysia, regardless of halal status. The halal certificate is a separate voluntary scheme.
faq.answer_layman_en: Halal does not replace NPRA. Notify first, then market.
faq.answer_formal_bm: Tidak. Notifikasi Kosmetik dengan NPRA di bawah Peraturan-Peraturan Kawalan Dadah dan Kosmetik 1984 diperlukan sebelum kosmetik dipasarkan di Malaysia, tanpa mengira status halal. Sijil halal ialah skim sukarela yang berasingan.
faq.answer_layman_bm: Halal tidak menggantikan NPRA. Notifikasi dahulu, baru pasarkan.
